## Introduction

In this homework, I will explore the Seoul Bike Sharing
dataset and use multiple linear regression to predict
daily bike rentals. I will first clean and summarize the
data, then compare three regression models using their
test-set RMSE.

## Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)
```

## Read the Data

The dataset contains hourly bike rental information
along with weather and calendar variables.

```{r}
bike_data <- read_csv(
  "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1")
)

head(bike_data)
dim(bike_data)
```
